description: This file contains test cases for the GatewayDiscoveryModel in the OpenClawDiscovery module. It tests functions such as isLocalGateway, parseGatewayTXT, buildSSHTarget, and discovery logic related to gateways and their deduplication.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.LocalIdentity
classes.description: Represents the local identity of a gateway, including host tokens and display tokens.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Represents a discovered gateway with details like host, port, IDs, and local/remote status.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines if a given set of gateway attributes matches the local gateway identity.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of gateway TXT record fields into a structured object.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Builds SSH target string from user, host, and port.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.shouldContinueTailscaleServeDiscovery
methods.description: Decides if Tailscale serve discovery should continue based on current and ongoing gateways.

methods.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.dedupeKey
methods.description: Generates a deduplication key for a gateway based on its endpoint or stable ID.
